title: valeriana officinalis subsp. sambucifolia
intro: Valeriana officinalis subsp. sambucifolia, commonly known as the Valerian 'Sambac' or  'Sambac Valerian', is a subspecies of the valerian plant, characterized by its clusters of small, white or pale purple flowers. The health benefits of Valeriana officinalis subsp. sambucifolia include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to calm the nervous system and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana officinalis subsp. sambucifolia include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
